ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered graph intelligence platform that detects suspicious financial flows and anomalous transaction patterns within college cooperative societies and campus canteens using LightGBM.
ideas.title: CampusGraph AML: Automated Compliance & Risk Network for Student Cooperatives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Best Build track by featuring hard backend engineering and financial graph analysis, closely mirroring successful pattern designs from audited AML platforms.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform that tracks local land use changes, deforestation, and crop health violations for regional municipal authorities.
ideas.title: AgriSustain-ATLAS: Satellite Monitoring for Local Agricultural Land Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Best Innovation track by leveraging complex spatial data parsing and environmental compliance metrics that appeal to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace where student freelancers deploy task-execution agents with automated USDC escrow payments settled on Base.
ideas.title: CampusNexus: Autonomous AI Agent Marketplace with USDC Escrow for Student Services
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets Realm Champion by combining cutting-edge multi-agent orchestration with decentralized escrow transactions for a polished, production-ready feel.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition platform that analyzes hostel mess menus and delivers personalized meal recommendations, macro tracking, and dietary guidance for college students.
ideas.title: NutriCampus: Personalized Mess Nutrition & Wellness Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the Best Build track by solving a hyper-local, relatable problem for students with a clean frontend and reliable recommendation algorithms.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support system utilizing LangGraph and RAG to audit campus energy consumption, answer sustainability queries, and manage eco-friendly initiatives.
ideas.title: EcoCampus-AI: Multi-Agent Sustainability Support & Carbon Tracking Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Optimized for Best Innovation through advanced multi-agent workflow architecture and practical application to institutional green metrics.
